title: 比较结构
goal: 能排列比较级、最高级、同等程度及相关变化的比较结构。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 排出 as … as 结构

body.p: 比较结构要写清和谁比、比哪一方面。比较级后面用 than。同等程度用 as + 形容词或副词原级 + as。两边比的要是同一类东西，价格只和价格比。

body.box:
This camera is lighter than the old one.
This camera is as light as the old one.
The price of this camera is lower than that of the old one.

body.p: much 和 a lot 放在比较级前面，表示差别大。much 不放在原级形容词前面代替 very。最高级是在一个范围里比，句子里要写出这个范围。

cards.title: 比较级与程度
rows: 较短形容词
加 -er 构成比较级，前面不再加 more。
This cable is longer than the old one.
较长形容词
用 more + 形容词。
This adapter is more convenient than the old one.
不规则变化
good / well 用 better，bad / badly 用 worse。
The new speaker sounds better than the old one.
than 的位置
than 后面接比较对象，也可以接从句。
The cable is longer than I expected.
much + 比较级
much 放在比较级前面，表示差别大。
The adapter is much smaller than the old one.
a lot + 比较级
a lot 放在比较级前面，用法和 much 相同。
The speaker is a lot clearer than the old one.
比较对象一致
物品比物品，价格比价格。后一个可以用 that 或 those 代替。
The price is lower than that of the other model.

cards.title: as … as 结构
rows: 形容词原级
两个 as 之间用原级，不用比较级。
This screen is as bright as the other one.
副词原级
比较动作的方式用副词。
This scanner works as quickly as the other one.
否定比较
not as … as 表示前者比不上后者。
This screen is not as bright as the other one.
as much + 不可数名词
much 后面接不可数名词，再接第二个 as。
This scanner uses as much energy as the other one.
as many + 复数名词
many 后面接可数名词复数。
This device has as many ports as the other one.
比较从句
第二个 as 后面可以接从句。
The screen is as bright as I expected.

cards.title: 最高级与关联比较
rows: 最高级形式
短词加 -est，长词用 most，两者不同时用。
This is the smallest unit in the range.
限定范围
in 后面接地点或群体，of 后面接参加比较的几样东西。
It is the cheapest of the three models.
最高级与限定词
最高级前面一般用 the，也可以用所有格。
This is our most reliable model.
one of + 最高级
后面的可数名词用复数。
It is one of the most useful accessories.
the more … the more
前一部分变化，后一部分跟着变化。
The more data we store, the more space we need.
其他关联比较级
两部分可以用不同的比较级。
The larger the screen is, the easier the text is to read.

body.box:
How does the new recorder compare with the older one?
It is ______ ______ ______ ______ .
than / quieter / much / the older one / more

body.p: quieter 已经是比较级，much 放在它前面表示差别大。than 引出比较对象 the older one。more quieter 把比较级用了两次，是错的。

body.box: It is much quieter than the older one.

body.p: 改成同等程度时，quieter 也要换成原级：It is as quiet as the older one.

items.stem: Does the new router cost more?
items.why: less expensive 表示更便宜，than 后面是比较对象。expense 是名词，这里要用形容词 expensive。

items.stem: Is the replacement fan quieter?
items.why: much 修饰比较级 quieter，than 引出另一台风扇。quietest 是最高级，不能接 than。

items.stem: Which headset is easiest to carry?
items.why: of the three headsets 是比较范围，三个里面选一个，用最高级 the lightest。lighter 是比较级。

items.stem: Does adding storage affect the price?
items.why: 两部分都用 the more，表示存储越多价格越高。后半句是 the more it costs。most 是最高级，这里用比较级 more。

items.stem: Are the two speakers equally loud?
items.why: as … as 中间用原级 loud，不用比较级 louder。

items.stem: Does the replacement keyboard feel equally comfortable?
items.why: is 后面描述键盘，用形容词 comfortable。comfortably 是副词，不能作表语。

items.stem: Does this receiver use the same amount of electricity?
items.why: electricity 不可数，所以用 as much electricity as，不用 many。

items.stem: Can the recorder store the same number of tracks?
items.why: tracks 是可数名词复数，所以用 as many tracks as，不用 much。

items.stem: Is the new remote easier to use?
items.why: a lot 修饰比较级 simpler，than 引出比较对象。simplest 是最高级，不能接 than。

items.stem: Is this mount the most secure one in the set?
items.why: 在四个支架里选最牢固的一个，用 the most secure of，不用比较级 more secure。

items.stem: Does this extension cord reach as far as the other one?
items.why: not as long as 表示比另一根短。as … as 中间用原级，不用 longer。

items.stem: Does the new charger work at the expected speed?
items.why: 修饰动词 works 用副词 quickly，不用形容词 quick。第二个 as 后面接 the manufacturer promised。

items.stem: Is the replacement hinge stronger?
items.why: much 放在比较级 stronger 前面，than 引出比较对象。strongest 是最高级，不能接 than。

items.stem: Does the new filter housing take up less space?
items.why: a lot 修饰比较级 smaller，than 引出旧外壳。smallest 是最高级，不能接 than。

items.stem: Is the new scanner easier to use than the old one?
items.why: more convenient 是比较级，than 引出旧扫描仪。convenience 是名词，这里要用形容词。

items.stem: Which of the three lamps is most efficient?
items.why: 在三盏灯里选效率最高的一盏，用 the most efficient of。more efficient 是比较级。

items.stem: Does increasing the image resolution affect file size?
items.why: 前半句 the higher，后半句 the more，表示分辨率越高、文件越大。后半句的主语是 the file，space 是 requires 的宾语。

items.stem: Does the new mattress have the same firmness?
items.why: as … as 表示同等程度，中间用原级 firm，不能用 firmer。

items.stem: Is the desk drawer as deep as the cabinet drawer?
items.why: not as deep as 表示这个抽屉比柜子的抽屉浅。as … as 中间用原级，不用 deeper。

items.stem: Does the compact freezer hold the same quantity of food?
items.why: food 在这里不可数，所以用 as much food as，不用 many。

items.stem: Do the two organizers contain the same number of compartments?
items.why: compartments 是可数名词复数，所以用 as many compartments as，不用 much。

items.stem: Does the new door closer operate as smoothly as expected?
items.why: 修饰动词 operates 用副词 smoothly，不用形容词 smooth。第二个 as 后面接 the installer predicted。
